argv:
> "$HOME/logs/bootstrap-laravel.status" && echo empty || true
if [ -f "$HOME/logs/bootstrap-laravel.status" ]; then echo "==STATUS=="; cat "$HOME/logs/bootstrap-laravel.status"; fi
echo "==LOG_TAIL=="; tail -30 "$HOME/logs/bootstrap-laravel.log" 2>/dev/null || echo NO_LOG
echo "==QUEUE=="; ls -la "$HOME/queue" 2>/dev/null
echo "==PUBLIC_SAAS=="; ls -a /home/appontrack/public_html/saas | head -20
echo "==ARTISAN=="; if [ -x /home/appontrack/public_html/saas/artisan ]; then cd /home/appontrack/public_html/saas && /opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php artisan --version 2>&1 | head -3; else echo NO_ARTISAN; fi
echo "=DONE="
